en: The image is a black-and-white vintage photograph of a grand public square with a prominent equestrian statue in the center. The square is surrounded by ornate historic buildings, some with domed roofs and decorative facades. There are people walking and sitting on benches, and a few classic cars are visible. The text in the upper right corner reads: 'CLUJ – Piața Libertății'.
